exports.name: TogglePasswordComponent
exports.summary:
Toggle button placed inside a `mat-form-field` that switches its sibling
`input[type="password"]` between masked and plain text.
exports.summaryZh:
放置在 `mat-form-field` 内的切换按钮，用于将同级的 `input[type="password"]`
在密文与明文之间切换显示。

methods.name: togglePassword
methods.description: Toggles the sibling input between password and plain-text display.
methods.descriptionZh: 切换同级输入框在密码与明文显示之间的状态。

properties.name: showPassword
properties.description: Whether the sibling password input currently shows plain text (`true`) or is masked (`false`).
properties.descriptionZh: 同级密码输入框当前是否显示为明文（`true`）还是密文（`false`）。

properties.name: hideToggle
properties.description: Whether to hide the toggle button entirely (set when no sibling `input[type="password"]` is found).
properties.descriptionZh: 是否完全隐藏切换按钮（当未找到同级 `input[type="password"]` 时设置为 `true`）。

exports.name: TogglePasswordModule
exports.summary: Angular module `TogglePasswordModule` declaring and exporting toggle password module components, directives, pipes, and providers.
exports.summaryZh: Angular 模块 `TogglePasswordModule`，声明并导出开关密码模块相关的组件、指令、管道与服务提供者。
